buyer_question: Should we use an AI chatbot for refund and complaint tickets?

proof_asset_to_cite: AI answer bank plus comparison matrix showing risky-response exclusion gates
human_review_gate: Human owner signs off refund, payment, defect, legal/privacy/security and public-claim boundaries
unsafe_claim_to_block: Do not provide refund/legal/privacy/security advice or automate financial commitments from this readiness asset

human_review_gate: Support/product/finance owner validates redacted fields and escalation paths
